queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS n
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM r
)
SELECT SUM(r.n) AS total_films, AVG(r.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_above
FROM r, a
WHERE r.n > a.avg_n;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), a AS (
  SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c
)
SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_films_in_stock, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_above_average
FROM c, a
WHERE c.n > a.av;
WITH per_store AS (
  SELECT f.rating, i.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS n
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating, i.store_id
),
per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, SUM(n) AS total
  FROM per_store
  GROUP BY rating
),
avg_t AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM per_rating
)
SELECT SUM(total) AS total_films_in_stock,
       AVG(total - a) AS avg_above_average
FROM per_rating, avg_t
WHERE total > a;
WITH rc AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS cnt
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM rc
)
SELECT SUM(rc.cnt) AS total_films_in_stock, AVG(rc.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_above_average
FROM rc, a
WHERE rc.cnt > a.avg_cnt;
